summary: wormgpt-cli ships implant/stealer modules with C2 protocol and clipboard/system exfiltration
details: Package name self-describes as a WormGPT CLI and ships an `src/implant/` tree containing a stealer suite. `src/implant/implant.js` spawns `bash`, `powershell`, and `screenc*` child processes. `src/implant/stealers/clipboard.js` runs `execSync('powershell...')` to capture clipboard contents. `src/protocol.js` combines `child_process`, `http`/`https`, `process.env` reads, and hostname/id fields into a POST-based C2 protocol, and `src/tui/app.js` reads local files via `fs.readFileSync`, gathers `os.homedir()` and hostname/id data, and POSTs it over http/https. The package's structure (implant + stealers + protocol + operator TUI) and behavior (arbitrary shell execution, clipboard capture, filesystem reads, system-info collection, network beaconing) constitute a functional remote-access implant with data exfiltration and command execution against the host on which it is loaded.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
